name: instrument_reader_db
description: instrument_reader-Datenbank (SQLite): OCR-Messwerte je ROI mit Run und Experiment, als Long-Tabelle. readings.timestamp ist Lokalzeit; ungültige Lesungen (is_valid = 0) werden zu leeren Werten.

sqlite.query: SELECT r.timestamp, e.id AS experiment_id, e.name AS experiment_name, e.voc_type, r.run_id, ru.target_temperature, ru.parameters_json AS run_parameters, r.phase_status, r.roi_name, CASE WHEN r.is_valid = 1 THEN r.parsed_value END AS parsed_value, r.unit, r.is_calculated FROM readings r JOIN runs ru ON ru.id = r.run_id JOIN experiments e ON e.id = ru.experiment_id ORDER BY r.timestamp, r.id
